title: Journey into Nyx: card flavor text

entities.name: Elspeth
entities.description: A Planeswalker who fights the gods of Theros and fears her trespass into Nyx.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A Planeswalker who vows to match Thassa and wants a riptide chimera.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A Planeswalker known as the Nightmare Weaver.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: The god of revels, who has fallen.

entities.name: Polyxene the Doubter
entities.description: A mortal who questions Heliod's favor.

entities.name: Kanlos
entities.description: An Akroan captain.

entities.name: Callaphe
entities.description: A mariner who hears sirens.

entities.name: Verenes
entities.description: A priest of Iroas who distrusts Phenax.

entities.name: Cymede
entities.description: The queen of Akros.

entities.name: Rhexenor
entities.description: An Akroan flamespeaker.

entities.name: Anthousa of Setessa
entities.description: A Setessan who speaks of a cyclops's contagious anger.

entities.name: Perisophia
entities.description: A philosopher who says the gods think of mortals as insects.

entities.name: Ianthe
entities.description: A Setessan hunter who met dryads.

entities.name: Guruthes
entities.description: A disciple of Xenagos who mourns his fall.

entities.name: Kytheon Iora
entities.description: Leader of infamous irregulars whose tactics Akroan hoplites revived.

entities.name: Kaliaros
entities.description: Helmsman of the Champion's former crew, found pinned beneath rotted planks.

entities.name: Photine
entities.description: The captain of the Champion's former crew.

entities.name: The Champion
entities.description: The hero of The Theriad.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: God of the sea, who speaks scornfully of mortal strength.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: God of deception, born of lies and betrayal.

entities.name: Pharika
entities.description: God of affliction who speaks of her adopted children.

entities.name: Nylea
entities.description: God of the hunt.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of the dead who promises nothing but eternity.

entities.name: Athreos
entities.description: God concerned with safe passage for the dead.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The sun god who gave mortals some favor.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: A god who hid dire prophecies about humankind.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: God of the forge who shaped the oreads.

entities.name: Keranos
entities.description: A god of storms served by a flamespeaker.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: A twin god, different from Mogis in looks and personality.

entities.name: Mogis
entities.description: A twin god, different from Iroas.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: The harvest god who made a home for mortals.

entities.name: Ephara
entities.description: A god who taught mortals to feel stone.

entities.name: Thraxes
entities.description: An ancient dragon who sleeps in Purphoros's sacred peak.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane of gods and mortals.

entities.name: Nyx
entities.description: The realm of the gods, which Elspeth trespasses into.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: A city of Theros guarded by soldiers and mastiffs.

entities.name: Meletis
entities.description: A city founded on ideas.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: The realm of the dead, whose coins are clay masks.

entities.name: Battle of Pharagax Bridge
entities.description: A battle after which the Champion lived among the leonin.

entities.name: Pheres-Band
entities.description: A band of warrior centaurs.

entities.name: The Theriad
entities.description: A written epic about the Champion.

events.summary: Elspeth announces that a god has been slain.
After the Battle of Pharagax Bridge, the Champion spends months among the leonin of Oreskos.
events.quote: After the Battle of Pharagax Bridge, the Champion spent many months among the leonin of Oreskos.

events.summary: A rotted hulk rises from the sea and looms over the Champion, with the bodies of Kaliaros and Photine pinned beneath it.
events.quote: The hulk rose from the sea and loomed over the Champion.

events.summary: The Champion and her companions arrive after a battle to find a solitary minotaur amid the carnage.
events.quote: The Champion and her companions marched through the night, but the battle was over before they arrived.

events.summary: Elspeth fears her trespass into Nyx will not go unanswered.
events.quote: Elspeth feared that her trespass into Nyx would not go unanswered.

events.summary: Xenagos has fallen, and his disciple Guruthes mourns him.
events.quote: "Xenagos has fallen, and the world grows dark without him.

events.summary: At the Akroan gates, hoplites revive the tactics of Kytheon Iora's irregulars.
events.quote: At the Akroan gates, hoplites revived the tactics of Kytheon Iora's infamous irregulars.

relations.note: Guruthes is a disciple of Xenagos.

relations.quote: "I will match Thassa drop for drop and show a god what true power is."
